exposure: preoperative vaginal cleansing using povidone-iodine solution 10%
cohort: 226 pregnant women scheduled for term elective cesarean section
finding: Preoperative vaginal cleansing with povidone-iodine solution 10% prior to elective CS appears to be effective in reducing rates of post-CS infectious morbidity, mainly endometritis.
mod_finding: This study focuses on the impact of vaginal cleansing on post-cesarean infection rates and does not involve a comparison of different modes of delivery.
